explanation: Ono–Swaminathan (arXiv:2509.09553, §1) recall Subbarao's conjecture that every arithmetic progression contains infinitely many even and infinitely many odd values of p(n), with the even case proved in full by Ono. The formal statement: for every r and t > 0, infinitely many n ≡ r (mod t) have p(n) even. Faithful.
